items.title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
items.summary: The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed the B1 bombers from the base in England back to their home stations in America.

items.title: What prompted the US bombers to leave RAF Fairford?
items.summary: The mass evacuation of American bombers from the UK points to concern in the Pentagon, our security correspondent writes.

items.title: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
items.summary: Archer sold more than 300 million books in his five-decade writing career, and his last book, Adam and Eve, was due to be released later this month.

items.title: King's funding for Andrew not to be used for legal action against police
items.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor is taking action over search warrants issued ahead of his arrest in February.

items.title: France braces for national day of school protests after injuries and mass arrests
items.summary: France prepares for a day of protests in support of students who’ve been demanding more investment in education.

items.title: Tories pledge £10bn 'Britannia Shield' air defence system
items.summary: The Conservatives said their plan would protect the UK at a time when Nato allies have warned of Russian drone incursions.

items.title: Europe is pouring billions into space. Can Glasgow's satellite industry keep up?
items.summary: The city's space boom raises questions about the role of the state in backing important industries.

items.title: MPs call for investigation after Lutnick-Epstein whistleblower dies
items.summary: Simon Andriesz said he felt let down by the UK's Financial Conduct Authority before his death last month.
